name: The Legend of the Blue Sea
description: A mermaid from the Joseon period ends up in present-day Seoul, where she crosses paths with a swindler who may have ties to someone from her past.

videos.title: The Legend Continues
videos.overview: SBS announced that on December 29, it will not be airing the drama’s 14th episode. Instead, a special feature that stitches together popular scenes from the first 13 episodes will be shown. Focusing on the relationship between Jun Ji-hyun and Lee Min-ho that transcends time, the special episode will be formatted like a director’s cut version of the drama.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In 1958, the nobleman Dam-Ryung releases a mermaid back into the ocean. In present-day Seoul, the figure of conman Joon-Jae stands on the same spot.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Joon-Jae brings a beautiful woman back to his hotel, unaware that she's a mermaid. Jin-Ok realizes she's been scammed and sends men after Joon-Jae.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: With no memory, Joon-Jae finds himself alone on a beach next to a jade bracelet and a single pearl. Meanwhile, the mermaid crosses the ocean to Seoul.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: At the aquarium, Joon-Jae runs into a woman being chased by security. Feeling a sense of déjà vu, Joon-Jae rescues her and brings her home.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Joon-Jae lives with the woman who he names Sim Chung. Fugitive Dae-Young has been on the run for 3 months when a murder occurs near Joon-Jae's house.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sim Chung is involved in a traffic accident. Joon-Jae rushes to the hospital to find her in critical condition.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Joon-Jae tells Sim Chung he loves her. Meanwhile, detective Hong comes across Dae-Young while investigating a murder.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jung-Hoon teaches Sim Chung that jealousy is the way to a man's heart. Meanwhile, Joon-Jae sees an image of a man with a mermaid on an ancient vase.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Joon-Jae finally faces off with his pursuer Dae-Young. He suffers a major injury and confesses his feelings to Sim Chung before losing consciousness.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In a museum, Joon-Jae sees a figure in a painting that looks just like him. Unable to identify the figure as Dam-Ryung, he grows distraught.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Sim Chung leaves the house after learning Joon-Jae is a conman. In a panic, Joon-Jae desperately searches for her.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Joon-Jae is arrested by detective Hong. When Sim Chung realizes they are in danger, she tracks them down.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Joon-Jae is still having strange dreams. Sim Chung hears Joon-Jae say the name Se-Hwa in his sleep. She asks him who he is talking about.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: With Professor Jin's help, Joon-Jae learns he is an ancestor of Dam-Ryung. To avoid a tragic fate, he decides to protect Sim Chung whatever it takes.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Sim Chung's heart will stop without Joon-Jae's love. Upon learning this, Joon-Jae talks about his dreams and finding out that Sim Chung is a mermaid.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Joon-Jae and Yoo-Ran have an emotional reunion at Sim Chung's birthday party. Joon-Jae learns why Dae-Young has been chasing him.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: After almost being caught by Dae-Young, Sim Chung erases his memory. In the process, she witnesses the final moments of Dam-Ryung and Se-Hwa.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: After Il-Joong's death, detective Hong gets a warrant to search Seo-Hee for evidence. Meanwhile, Chi-Hyun threatens Nam-Doo to get him to cooperate.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Chi-Hyun points a gun at Joon-Jae, but Sim Chung jumps in front and is shot. She slips into a coma, causing Joon-Jae to fall into despair.

videos.title: Final
videos.overview: Sim Chung erases Joon-Jae's memory and returns to the ocean. When Joon-Jae wakes up, there's only a single pearl next to him. Three years pass...
